short_script_en: Welcome to another hardware preservation showcase, featuring the NEC PC Engine CoreGrafx, model PI-TG3, a sleek revision of the legendary 8-bit powerhouse that introduced AV output to the Japanese market. This specific OEM unit retains its original dark grey casing and signature blue lettering, serving as a vital reference piece for retro gaming historians studying late 1980s console aesthetics. Preserving this authentic hardware ensures future generations can study the exact engineering and custom silicon that made HuCard gaming an unforgettable era in Japanese electronic history.
